name: Literary Theory
description: The following theoretical approaches, topics and themes will be taught in the course: what is theory itself, what is literature; literature and culture; language, meaning, interpretation; rhetoric, poetics, poetry; narrative; performatives; identity, decolonial thought; psychoanalysis and literary theory; hermeneutics.
